sentences.en: She took in the washing when it started to rain.
sentences.zh: 下雨了，她把要洗的衣服收进来了。

sentences.en: Could you tell me how to use this washing machine?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我怎么用这台洗衣机吗？

sentences.en: My father has been washing his car since this morning.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸今天早上就开始洗车了。

senses.zh: 要洗的衣物；洗好的衣物
